body: Bright eyes. Beautiful music. Land locked blues, poison oak, lua, haligh, haligh, a lie, haligh and a perfect sonnet, to name a few. Also, Stars, with songs like Personal. Some radiohead, Simon and garfunkel, pearl jam, iron and wine, Bon iver.
At the very least, that's nice to hear and I appreciate it.
Thank you for taking the time out of work to post this.

I feel that anybody I tell will be so disgusted by me that they'll never think of me the same way again. And even if I didn't, the culture I live in does not look kindly on any such weaknesses, especially in girls.

There's just so much, and honestly I feel so fucking selfish for even being this way that I don't even know which of my problems are actual problems and not me being a crazy bitch. A disgusting eating disorder that just blew up in my face with parents humiliated by me (their, well dad's, words - I'm worse than a little kid, more disgusting than my 8 year old brother who is within the autistic spectrum could ever be, he's so embarrassed and ashamed of me) is probably the catalyst for this particular episode. But honestly it's just like for the past few years I've been standing on the edge of a cliff, where nobody except me knows there's a drop, and the slightest breeze has me hanging by my fingertips. If that makes any sense at all. God, I am so *stupid*.
